label: Gas utility / pipeline
description: A natural gas local distribution company or a transmission pipeline operator: city gates and regulator stations, mains and services, compressor stations and mainline valves, storage and LNG, a gas control room on SCADA, field servicepersons and the customers on the system.

vocabulary.facility: the gas system (city gates, regulator stations, mains, compressor stations and the gas control room)
vocabulary.public: customers and the neighborhoods along the mains and the pipeline right-of-way
vocabulary.frontline: gas controllers, gas servicepersons, measurement and regulation technicians, locators, call-center agents

it: work and asset management with mobile dispatch
GIS of mains, services and valves
gas nomination and scheduling, and the interstate pipeline electronic bulletin board
ot: pipeline SCADA (gas control) with HMI, historian and alarm management
RTUs at regulator stations, city gates, compressor stations and valve sites
remote-control and automatic shut-off valves (RCV / ASV)
compressor unit control panels and station emergency shutdown (ESD)
electronic flow measurement, gas chromatographs and odorant injection
radio, cellular and satellite telemetry links

roles.name: VP Gas Operations (Incident Commander)
roles.description: Activates the emergency plan, approves curtailment and large-area shutdowns, and requests mutual assistance.

roles.name: Gas Control Manager
roles.description: Owns system pressure, line pack, segment isolation, the 1-hour NRC call, and manual operation if SCADA is lost.

roles.name: Cybersecurity Coordinator / OT-SCADA Manager (Technical Lead)
roles.description: The TSA security directive Cybersecurity Coordinator: owns the CISA report, the incident response plan and isolating gas control from the business network.

roles.name: Field Operations Supervisor (Measurement and Regulation)
roles.description: Owns servicepersons on odor calls, regulator station checks, manual valve closures and relights.

roles.name: Corporate Security Manager
roles.description: Owns the physical security of compressor and city-gate stations and the law-enforcement liaison.

roles.name: Corporate Communications / Public Awareness Manager (PIO)
roles.description: Owns media, evacuation and relight notices, and the smell-gas-act-fast messaging.

outsideParties: the state pipeline safety program (often the PUC)
the 911 PSAP and the fire department
the 811 one-call center and the locate contractor
large customers (a hospital, a gas-fired power plant)
mediaChannels: local TV breaking news with a live shot of the evacuation
Nextdoor posts reporting a gas smell
a Reddit thread about the outage and relights

sceneAnchors.public: a suburban residential street with a gas utility service truck, a technician in a hard hat holding a gas detector at a house meter, neighbors on the sidewalk, daylight
sceneAnchors.control: inside a gas control room: controllers at a long console with headsets, a large dark pipeline schematic wall, alarm lights, low lighting
sceneAnchors.exterior: a fenced natural gas compressor station: compressor buildings, above-ground pipes and valves painted yellow, a gravel yard, cloudy sky

noiseExamples: a customer asking why the bill went up
a contractor calling about a missed 811 locate
a meter set damaged by a snowplow
a routine odorant level check at a regulator station
a printer jam in gas control
pressureExamples: dozens of posts saying the whole neighborhood smells of gas
a reporter asking whether the pipeline was shut down by hackers
drivers posting long lines and empty pumps at gas stations
a council member demanding a date for relights
a care home asking when its heat will be back
